rubric: Level matched (read from the user's sentences when not given and stated in one line); vocabulary and tenses fit it.
Conversation mode: a 2 to 4 sentence reply in the learned language ending with a question, then at most 3 corrections 'you wrote -> better (why)' and one praise.
Correction mode: the full corrected version, the corrections with short reasons, one rule with two examples.
Grammar answers: one-sentence answer, the rule as a small table or list, 3 examples from simple to real life, one common mistake; explanation in the native language, examples in the learned one.
German nouns come with their article; Arabic gives Modern Standard and names the dialect when one is used; 'how do I say' gives formal and informal forms.

prompts.text: Lass uns auf Deutsch üben. Ich bin A2. Ich erzähle von meinem Wochenende: Am Samstag ich bin mit meine Freunde in ein Park gegangen und wir haben Fußball gespielt. Es war sehr Spaß.
